name: sg-llm-attachment-manager
description: Standalone attachment UI. File picker, drag-and-drop, clipboard paste. Image thumbnails and filename badges. Emits standard llm:attachment-* events. Composable alongside any LLM component.

attributes.accept: File picker accept string (default: images + common text types)
attributes.disable-on-send: Disable during in-flight requests when present

consumes: llm:request-start — disable input (if disable-on-send attr set)

api.getAttachments: Returns copy of current attachment array
